description: A scheduled check finds an idle session and unassigned work. The coordinator polls the session and, on its idle reply, hands it the next task that fits, asking the user nothing. The rename is a naming call and is never handed; nothing is launched without a yes.

graders.name: reads the coordinator-sessions skill before the first session action
graders.rule: Poll that session first and stop there.

graders.name: no hand-off is asked of the user
graders.pattern: (?i)\b(should I|shall I|want me to|ok to|okay to|do you want)\b[^.?\n]*\b(give|hand|assign|send|fixer)

graders.name: Log times are this move's clock reads

turns.prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/7719.sock" from-name="7719-fixer" from-mode="prompting">
Current task: nothing, the docstring fix is closed.
idle
Waiting on: nobody.
Free: now.
Blocked: no.
Constraints: none. Subagents: none.
</cross-session-message>
